product.title: Peekaboo Slot Canyon 4WD Tour

description.text: Explore Peekaboo Slot Canyon on a private 4WD tour with off-road transfer from the Kanab area through red rock backcountry to one of southern Utah's most photogenic narrows. Your guide navigates sandy desert tracks to the slot entrance, then leads a short hike through twisting sandstone walls with time for photography in the chamber-like passages. This three-hour outing focuses on unique slot canyon scenery outside the Zion National Park shuttle zone without the commitment of a full-day loop. Return transfer, trail guidance, and photo tips are included for photographers and first-time slot canyon visitors.

highlights: Private 4WD transfer to Peekaboo Slot Canyon
Guided hike through narrow sandstone passages
Dedicated photo time in slot canyon chambers
Off-road desert approach from Kanab area

start.description: Meet at the Kanab meeting point confirmed at booking. Wear sturdy hiking shoes and sun protection.

end.description: Return transfer to Kanab after the slot canyon photo stop.
